title: SQL Server query-based: a datetime2(7) cursor misses changed rows

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, query-based, one run

symptom: With a datetime2(7) cursor, rows whose seventh digit changed didn't arrive (0 of 3). A datetime2(6) control on the same data arrived 2 of 2. The incremental update COMPLETED.
cause: Not isolated; the seventh digit of the cursor appears to be lost.
effect: Incremental rows are missing with COMPLETED.
fix: Use a datetime2(6) or lower cursor until the case is checked.
notes: The lookback wasn't varied. A 100,000-row UPDATE on a 10M-row table reached 0 rows in two incremental runs, but that test may not have changed the cursor column.
